extension.description: Chat with your local models from VS Code, through the ChatonLM app.
config.completion.enabled: Suggest code as you type with a model of ChatonLM on this computer. Off by default: the model is loaded only when you turn this on or choose **Prepare**, and only if there is room for it next to the chat model. Once on, if the model was unloaded after a while without typing, typing loads it again when both fit together.
config.completion.model: Autocomplete model, installed in ChatonLM. `auto`: the model ChatonLM recommends for this computer.
config.completion.multiline: Suggest several lines when the cursor is at the end of a line.
config.completion.ignoreOthers: Suggest with ChatonLM even where another extension (GitHub Copilot, Continue, Windsurf…) is turned on for the same language. By default ChatonLM stays quiet where another extension is clearly turned on, and only mentions it where this can't be known.
command.studyProject: Make a Course About This Project
command.studyLanguage: Make a Course About This Language
config.notify.enabled: Send a message through Easy Link (Telegram, Discord) when a terminal command, a task or a ChatonLM reply that took a while finishes. Only its name, how long it took and whether it worked are sent, never code or output. Off by default; **Let VS Code notify me through Easy Link** must also be on in ChatonLM, under Settings › Easy Link.
config.notify.minDurationSeconds: Only notify about what took at least this many seconds.
config.notify.includeFolderName: Add the name of the open folder to the message.
config.mcp.enabled: Let the agents of this editor (agent mode of the chat, Cline, Cursor…) use ChatonLM through MCP: ask a model on this computer, generate an image, read a text aloud, proofread a text, list the models. They get an access of their own, which ChatonLM limits to these tools: not your chats, not your settings. Off by default; turning it off withdraws that access. Every call is shown in the ChatonLM panel, where you can stop it or turn this off. VS Code must be paired with ChatonLM.
config.nativeChat.enabled: Offer ChatonLM's models in the model picker of VS Code's chat. Only models on this computer, never cloud models; each request is a temporary chat that ChatonLM deletes right after. Off by default.
